name: Inter-Satellite Link Relay Failure & Dynamic Intra-Plane Promotion
description: Validates autonomous peer detection and dynamic relay handover (Master Blueprint v2.0 Section 16 & 18). Primary relay SAT-08 in Plane B experiences critical transceiver burnout at t=2.0s. Surviving peers in Plane B detect link termination, attribute the hardware fault as unrecoverable, and autonomously promote healthy observer SAT-06 to RELAY, restoring intra-plane ISL communications without operator intervention.

scheduled_faults.description: Primary relay transceiver burnout on SAT-08 in Plane B
